FROM main.Patient AS p
LEFT JOIN main.Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID AND l.PLT > 400
WHERE p.SEX = 'F' AND p.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
GROUP BY p.Diagnosis

FROM main.Laboratory AS l

LIMIT 1
